name: Lilly Pulitzer
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $118 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Women's and girls' print dresses, led by the shift dress, plus tops, swim and resortwear, dresses about $200–$370, sold through its own stores and site and Nordstrom.
origin: Founded in Palm Beach, United States in 1959 by Lilly Pulitzer.

quote.q: The Lilly woman isn't sitting on the sidelines waiting for fate to determine her future.

opview: “The Lilly woman isn't sitting on the sidelines waiting for fate to determine her future.” — Lilly Pulitzer (house), About Us, lillypulitzer.com

facts_read.source: brand site; Oxford Industries 10-K FY2025 (filed 2026-03-27); nordstrom.com; Vinted catalog page; TRR designer directory; B Lab directory; GOTS database

Blouse.lp: Sea View Linen Button Down Shirt

price_read.sublines: Lilly Pulitzer incl. UPF 50 and Luxletic (activewear) lines; Jack Rogers (stocked) excluded from shoes; girls' excluded

doors.note: site lillypulitzer.com; 71 'Lilly Retail Store' records and 43 US 'Signature Stores', all own doors (incl. Lilly Pulitzer at The Ritz-Carlton Key Biscayne); 8 are marked inactive with every day closed (Nantucket, Edgartown, Watch Hill, Avalon, Montgomery Mall, Worth Avenue, Ocean Reef Club, Charleston), returned as temporarily closed and flagged; the locator shows no outlets, so the brief's 'outlet-heavy' note does not show for Lilly; the 43 Signature Stores are independently owned shops under the Lilly Pulitzer banner, operator 'independently owned Signature Store', counted as the brand's doors and flagged (ruled 10 Oct: a store under the brand's banner counts as the brand's whoever runs it); 53 department and specialty store stockists and 6 unlabelled partner records are wholesale, not doors, and are not returned

fibre.sample: stratified sample of 80 of 496 six-digit product codes read off 7 women's nodes at sz=1000 (swim, pajama and sleep handles removed; Loungewear added 2 styles no

tech_evidence.names: Luxletic (UPF 50+ performance line: Meryl® nylon pique, 'Studio Stretch', performance twill); UPF 50+ fabrications elsewhere; licensed Meryl®, LYCRA® T400®, LENZING ECOVERO
tech_evidence.owned: Luxletic owned; Meryl, LYCRA, ECOVERO licensed

craft_evidence.mills: no — one cashmere wrap names The Good Cashmere Standard (a certification, not a mill)
craft_evidence.madein: 1 of 80 states a country ('Made in America from imported fabric', a short); the rest say 'Imported'
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed as a retailer: 'Creating Sunshine Since 1959', Palm Beach shop — a shop's founding, not a making heritage
craft_evidence.process: no — prints are named by collection, not how they are made
craft_evidence.reasoning: No owned facility, maker or mill is named; 79 of 80 sampled pages say only 'Imported'. The 1959 Palm Beach story is dated and placed but is about a shop and its prints, not where things are made.
